Its reasoning is unexpectedly very good, and we even used it to replace tavily api and [URL_001] for retrieving information from the internet. Its image generation is good too—you can look at the AI blog—and it should also work well for the mood board. For the selfie-created styling, idk; you need to prompt it through the backend and send me the results.
